'''Gelens''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Gelens led a unit inside a [[Manka-class armored transport|''Manka''-class armored transport]] during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Their walker got shut down the whole team became trapped inside with limited air supply. Luckily, they were able to reach a Republic citizen on the holocomm, who brought along welding equipment and got Gelens and his men out.
